text:
You need an intermediate virtual assistant who communicates fast, learns unique tasks quickly, and can handle some repetitive but non-100% data entry work without getting bored.  

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, and I’m comfortable with structured, detail-oriented work that requires responsiveness and adaptability.  

On “Warehouse models for a DTC brand” for Fernwood Pantry, I built a dbt project with staging, intermediate, and mart layers for orders, subscriptions, and marketing, with 38 models and tests on 120 columns; it also helped move dashboard refreshes from daily to hourly.  

I’m eager to learn your unique workflows and can stay consistent on repetitive tasks while keeping communication clear and timely.
